title: Build a Platformer Game
tagline: Jump. Build. Collect. Create Your Own World.
guiding_rule: AI helps. People create. Ask a grown-up first.

missions.title: Anatomy of a Platformer
missions.kids: Discover the parts of a platformer: hero, platforms, goal, danger, and rewards.

missions.title: Design Your Hero
missions.kids: Create a hero with a name, skills, personality, and mission.

missions.title: Level 1: The Tutorial
missions.kids: Build a safe first level that teaches the player how to play.

missions.title: Level 2: The Challenge
missions.kids: Add harder jumps, surprises, traps, enemies, and better rewards.

missions.title: Power-Ups and Collectibles
missions.kids: Design coins, hearts, shields, keys, and special boosts.

missions.title: Sprite Design Workshop
missions.kids: Draw hero, enemy, item, and background sprites frame by frame.

missions.title: Game Pitch and Blueprint
missions.kids: Explain your game idea like a young game designer.
